verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe OneDrive Files On-Demand in File Explorer, letting users browse files without downloading them all, plus a right-click "Always keep on this device" option for offline access, so online-only files on Windows are documented. Community hands-on reports are mixed: some describe files deleted or reverted during sync, while others report years of trouble-free multi-machine syncing. These reports temper confidence but do not contradict the documented on-demand feature. Missing for 10: evidence of an official macOS desktop client, documented selective-sync (choose-folders) capability, and independent corroboration that sync is reliable across machines.
